bullets.text: In Velachery, an Odisha guest worker was stabbed to death in a money dispute, and the office should monitor the police investigation.
In Thiruvallur, a boiler leak at the North Chennai Thermal Power Station affected 600 MW of power generation, requiring close departmental watch.
In Taramani, a sewage pipe burst caused a road cave-in on MGR Road, and the office should coordinate immediate repairs with the Corporation.
The Greater Chennai Corporation reviewed monsoon flood readiness, including the widening of the Okkiyam Maduvu Canal in Adyar and Sholinganallur zones.
Residents of the TNHB quarters in Kanagam faced pressure from officials to vacate, and the office should review the legality of these actions.
Power supply will be suspended in parts of Velachery and Nehru Nagar due to maintenance work by TNPDCL, and the office should monitor restoration.
Out-of-state omni buses blocked the Gummidipoondi border checkpost in protest, creating heavy traffic disruption that the district team must watch.
Collector Kavitha inspected Rs 6 crore pre-monsoon works at Pazhaverkadu, and the office should track the timely completion of these drainage projects.
Karambakkam residents questioned the construction of a PDS shop on a pond waterbody, and the local administration should clarify the approvals.
The IT Ministry demanded Apple remove the offline messaging app Bitchat from the India store, which the portfolio team should monitor closely.
Coimbatore's global capability centres are projected to grow significantly by 2032, highlighting key regional tech expansion for the portfolio.
Underground sensors and AI are being used in Chennai to predict groundwater fluctuations, showcasing local smart water management applications.
Soumya Anbumani stated that pressure will be put on the TVK government to gradually reduce liquor shops, which the political team should note.
A netizen reacted to a state highways road project regarding language use on milestones, prompting the office to observe public feedback.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Ilaiyaraaja music centre at IIT Madras, blending culture and technology for the constituency.
